observations: The crate page can expose RustSec-backed security visibility.
A reviewer can inspect affected version ranges from the registry UI.
caveats: Security visibility does not prove ergonomic teaching fit.

observations: SLOC can make source size legible before adoption.
caveats: Source size is not a substitute for API simplicity or migration cost.

observations: Public docs may foreground a default target landing page and target list.
caveats: Visible target posture can change over time and may not match the team's deployment scope.

hidden_or_non_authoritative_axes: Teaching burden of macros and advanced trait machinery
Companion-crate requirements not obvious from the landing page
Exit cost if the team later prefers a lower-lock-in stack
